result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy the default mode of human connection — not something we have to practice, but something we naturally do, like breathing.

Imagine a world where every decision, every policy, every argument starts from genuinely feeling what another person feels. Wars would lose their momentum. Greed would lose its grip. Loneliness would lose its grip. We’d still disagree, but we’d disagree the way people who love each other do — with care, patience, and a stubborn refusal to dehumanize.

So much of the world’s suffering comes from an inability to truly see each other. If that changed, everything else would follow.
